title: OperationalAlertPayload
description: Standard alert event schema for SYS-06 Operational Alerting & Notification System

source_system.description: Identifier of the system originating the alert.

event.description: Unique event identifier code, in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE.

deduplicate_key.description: Stable deduplication key used to suppress repeated alerts within the 300s window.

message.description: Human-readable summary or explanation of the alert condition.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the event (e.g. 2026-08-23T11:45:00Z).

receiver_roles.description: Target audience roles that should receive this notification.

channels.description: Delivery channels requested for this alert.

action_url.description: Optional URL pointing to relevant dashboard, log viewer or portal for remediation.

suggested_action.description: Optional quick actionable recommendation for on-call personnel.

metadata.description: Flexible key-value payload containing contextual metric details.
